Turtle Tots' Charleville classes bring child-centred baby and toddler swimming to Rathgoggan North, Co. Cork, with lessons for babies as young as three months right through to age four and a half. Every session is adapted to the individual child, building up the separate techniques needed for independent swimming by the end of the baby programme.

Small, sociable classes are led by trained teachers who keep things playful while quietly building essential life-saving water skills. Places for the 6-12 month, 1, 2, 3 and 4 year old age groups run from €21.

The Kerry team focuses on fun, sociable classes that still cover the ground needed for independent swimming and core life-saving skills by the end of the programme. Classes start from €21.

Little Kickers brings its preschool football programme to Barnagore, County Cork, welcoming children from around 18 months through to age seven across four age-graded stages. Younger children start in parent-toddler sessions building balance, coordination and listening skills through play, before progressing to more independent classes.

By the final stage, children are combining everything they've learned into a short match, with the classes' "Play not Push" philosophy keeping the focus on fun rather than pressure throughout. Monthly fee is €50.

Sessions blend football with fundamental movement skills, sharing and early learning concepts, building toward a short match for the oldest group. €50 per month.
